content: python-kis (Soju06/python-kis) is an actively maintained community KIS REST+WebSocket Python library, v2.1.6 released 2025-10-13, supports Python 3.10-3.13, full mock (모의투자) account support, AppKey/SecretKey auth with automatic token management/refresh, real-time websocket with auto-reconnect, type hints, English naming. Strongest community KIS wrapper for 2025/2026.
